Implemented pure dispatch operation planning in dispatch_ops.py with DispatchOp/DispatchOpKind, DispatchBackend protocol, build_dispatch_plan, and IO-free kanban payload generation. CLI bridge dispatch now delegates to the planner while preserving full handoff comment bodies via injected payload builder. Added planner and CLI regression tests, documented the dispatch planner/backend protocol, and verified privacy scan, doc coverage, GitBook check, pytest, and non-editable dispatch smoke.

Implemented deterministic local-file dispatch queue backend in local_file_backend.py. Added stable local task IDs from canonical payload JSON, empty queue creation, append, duplicate skip semantics, corrupt queue errors, project-relative queue path resolution, and package smoke coverage. Verified privacy scan, doc coverage, GitBook docs, full pytest, and non-editable local-file smoke.

Implemented dispatch --apply for the local-file backend only. bridge dispatch now accepts --apply/--backend local-file/--queue-file, writes deterministic queue records through LocalFileQueueBackend, preserves dry-run/apply payload parity, rejects apply without the local-file backend or queue file, and keeps duplicate stable task IDs from appending. Verified with privacy scan, doc coverage, GitBook docs, pytest, and installed CLI smoke.

Dispatch now skips beads that already carry hermes_kanban_task_id, writes the local-file task id back to Beads after successful apply, and preserves dry-run/apply parity. Added CLI and compatibility coverage for metadata linkage, duplicate-skip behavior, and public-safe task ids.

Dispatch apply now writes the queued task link back to Beads and marks the bead in_progress with bd status so ready queue smoke tests no longer re-surface dispatched beads. Updated docs to state Beads status is canonical and hermes_status metadata is advisory.

Added temp-product smoke harnesses for source-tree and installed-wheel execution. The smoke loop now proves local-file dispatch apply, fake result sync, bead closure, and public-safe docs/commands from a fresh repo.

Extended the temp-product smoke loop to prove idempotency across two runs for both source-tree and installed-wheel execution. The second dispatch returns no tasks, the queue file stays unchanged, the bead remains closed, and result-sync does not duplicate comments.

Documented the temp-product smoke workflow in docs/local-smoke.md and linked it from the docs index. The docs now include exact source-tree and installed-wheel commands for init, dispatch, fake result generation, sync, and repeat checks.

Documented the current Hermes Kanban CLI contract in docs/hermes-kanban-backend.md, including the JSON shapes for boards/create/list/show/stats, the plain-text lifecycle commands, dispatch dry-run output, and the observed failure mode where missing-task lookups print to stderr but still exit 0.

Added a hermes subprocess backend and fake-hermes integration tests that validate create/show/complete command construction, JSON parsing, missing-task handling, and fail-before-mutating behavior without a live Hermes dependency.

Added hermes-cli dispatch apply backend wiring plus fake-hermes tests. The backend now shells out to Hermes, writes Beads linkage only after create succeeds, and leaves Beads metadata unchanged on Hermes failure. Updated docs and compatibility/smoke coverage; required gates passed.
